# Ivoniz Pvt Ltd

> Ivoniz Pvt Ltd (Ivoniz Technologies) is a digital marketing, website development, mobile app development, and AI solutions company headquartered in Kozhikode (Calicut), Kerala, India. Founded by Muhammed Anas, Ivoniz has delivered 1000+ websites and 100+ apps, holding a 4.9-star client rating.

## Key Facts

- Legal name: Ivoniz Technologies Pvt. Ltd.
- Founder: Muhammed Anas
- Headquarters: 7th Floor, Phase 1, HiLITE Business Park, Kozhikode, Kerala 673001, India
- Phone / WhatsApp: +91 96457 60023
- Email: info@ivoniz.com (general), sales@ivoniz.com (sales), hr@ivoniz.com (careers)
- Client rating: 4.9 / 5 (Google)
- Track record: 1000+ websites delivered, 100+ apps shipped
- Mission: Transform ideas into powerful digital experiences.
- Vision: To become a globally recognized technology company known for delivering innovative, reliable, and impactful digital solutions.

## Services

- Website Development & Design (Next.js, custom builds)
- Ecommerce Development (WooCommerce, custom)
- Mobile App Development (Flutter, React Native, native iOS/Android)
- Custom Software Development (ERP, CRM, Billing)
- AI Solutions & Automation
- Digital Marketing (SEO, SMM, SEM)
- Branding (logo, brochure design)
- UI/UX Design
- Cloud & Hosting Solutions
- Website Maintenance & Support

## Service Area

Calicut (Kozhikode), Kochi, and across Kerala, India — also serving clients nationally and internationally.
